definitions.gloss: the button used to turn an electrical device on or off
definitions.explanation: The hardware or on-screen button that switches an electronic device's power state. Found on computers, smartphones, televisions, game consoles, and other electronics. Often marked with the universal power symbol (⏻).

examples.japanese: {電源|でんげん}ボタンを{押|お}す。
{電源|でんげん}ボタンが{反応|はんのう}しない。
{電源|でんげん}ボタンを{3秒|さんびょう}{長押|ながお}しすると{再起動|さいきどう}します。
examples.english: If you hold down the power button for three seconds, the device will restart.

examples.japanese: この{機種|きしゅ}は{本体|ほんたい}の{右側面|みぎそくめん}に{電源|でんげん}ボタンが{付|つ}いている。
examples.english: On this model, the power button is located on the right side of the main body.

notes:
Composed of {電源|でんげん} (power source; electrical power) + ボタン (button, from English). A straightforward loan-compound used in product manuals, customer support, and everyday tech-support conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電源|でんげん}ボタンを{押|お}す: to press the power button
- {電源|でんげん}ボタンを{長押|ながお}しする: to hold down the power button
- {電源|でんげん}ボタンを{入|い}れる / {切|き}る: to turn the power on / off (via the button)
- {電源|でんげん}ボタンが{効|き}かない: the power button isn't working
- {電源|でんげん}ボタンを{2秒|にびょう}{間押|あいだお}しする: to press the power button for two seconds

RELATED WORDS:
- {電源|でんげん}: electrical power; power source
- {電源|でんげん}を{入|い}れる: to turn on (a device)
- {電源|でんげん}を{切|き}る: to turn off (a device)
- {起動|きどう}: startup; boot
- {再起動|さいきどう}: restart; reboot
- {強制|きょうせい}{終了|しゅうりょう}: forced shutdown
- {長押|ながお}し: long press; holding a button down

USAGE:
Instructions commonly combine {電源|でんげん}ボタン with verbs like {押|お}す (press), {長押|ながお}しする (hold down), and {押|お}し{続|つづ}ける (keep pressing). In troubleshooting, the phrase {電源|でんげん}ボタンを{10秒|じゅうびょう}{長押|ながお}し (hold the power button for 10 seconds) is a common instruction for a forced shutdown.
